title: Inspect saved rule scan progress
description: Use a disabled rule prepared by e2e-pr-source-checkpoints.mts. Preview reads must show their saved progress and observation window without activating the rule.

open.intent: The operator can inspect source coverage from the shared PR dashboard.

ready.intent: The authenticated dashboard exposes the persisted rule controls.

rules.intent: Saved discovery rules remain accessible independently of review workers.

rule.intent: The isolated rule's preview control is reachable in the inventory.

preview.intent: The operator resumes the rule's saved source traversal without enabling it.

progress.intent: Source progress is returned by the live gateway rather than inferred from UI activity.

show.intent: The saved page count and observation age are readable together.

capture.intent: The screenshot records actual saved-page progress and source coverage status.
